name: page_goto

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-9-3.1.32 image: 0xc4b456c is the body that logs the tag "goto_page_no_check_stacktop" (pagemanager) and runs the stock transition.

notes: Resolves the page key and pushes it through the stock transition (logs "Please register this page:%lu!" for an unknown key). The previous record pointed at lvx_pagemanager_prelaunch_check (0xc45b588), which only logs prelaunch state and shows no page.
